decisions.decision: Location field format standard: 'City ST' for a single-location day, 'City ST to City ST' for a travel day (no comma between city/state). Verified against Nebo maps (src/data/nebo-maps.json, real GPS route images with place-name labels) as the primary evidence source, post's own narrative text as secondary.
decisions.rationale: Matches the majority pre-existing convention across already-correct posts; Nebo maps are real ground-truth data.

decisions.decision: Multi-day post title format standard going forward: 'Days N to M - Title' (not 'Days N - M - Title', ambiguous double-hyphen). Paired with a new optional `dateEnd` frontmatter field (added to content.config.ts's zod schema this session) so the displayed date renders as a real range.
decisions.rationale: User explicitly requested this as the standing convention.

decisions.decision: When re-running scripts/import-blogger.mjs --refresh, always diff the newly-written files against the existing post list before building/committing â€” Blogger publish-date changes on already-migrated posts (from edits on the Blogger side) cause the script's filename-based dedup to miss them and write stray duplicates under a new date.
decisions.rationale: Discovered this session: 27 of 32 'new' files from a --refresh were actually shifted-date duplicates of already-fixed posts, not real new content.
